Why the company is called Chikku.
Inspiration: Chikku fruit
My name is inspired by the Chikku fruit, which is loved for its natural sweetness. Just like the fruit, Chikku Robotics focuses on creating human-centered, friendly, and trustworthy robots that easily integrate into your daily life.
